redTeam.$comment: statusLabels defaults true (WE_RED_TEAM_STATUS_LABELS override); head-bound derived status only, recorded results remain authoritative. skipCardOnly defaults true; card-only net diffs never schedule a pass. rerequest: when the drain holds an owed head with no red-team result past its deadline it posts one head-bound re-request and starts a red-team-only job; enabled (standard true, env WE_RED_TEAM_REREQUEST=off is the kill switch) and maxRequestsPerHead (standard 1, 0-5, env WE_RED_TEAM_REREQUEST_MAX_PER_HEAD) resolve standard < platform < tool < env with sources logged. A request is never a result: the PR stays held.
